The feature by default requires manual configuration in the tenant to prohibit cross-domain logins. To strengthen security with cross-domain sign-in we will change the default rule for federatedTokenValidationPolicy to block logins where internalDomainFederation does not match UPN domain. items.title: Microsoft Intune: Intune Suite - Unattended Remote Help for Windows - Remote Sign-in
items.desc: Remotely access devices over the cloud without requiring end user involvement by signing in with credentials.

items.title: Access: Design Access forms and reports without 22-inch size constraints
items.desc: With the removal of the 22-inch limit, your apps can now take full advantage of today’s larger monitors. You can display more data, create flexible layouts, and deliver a better experience on wide and high-resolution screens.
items.when: GA: June CY2026 · Preview: June CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Apply sensitivity labels with user-defined permissions in Office for the web in Microsoft 365
items.desc: Office for the web in Microsoft 365 supports the application of sensitivity labels with user-defined permissions.

items.title: Windows 365: Windows 365 Link - Customization of the login screen
items.desc: IT can set a custom wallpaper, company logo and name on the Windows 365 Link login screen

items.title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Introducing a new URL click alert in Teams via Microsoft Defender for Office 365
items.desc: We are introducing a new URL click alert that proactively notifies security teams when a user clicks on a malicious link in Teams, helping organizations quickly identify risk and respond before further impact occurs.
items.when: GA: March CY2026 · Preview: February CY2026

items.title: Exchange: Dynamic distribution groups now populate membership faster on creation and modification
items.desc: We're updating dynamic distribution groups (DDGs) in Exchange Online to make group membership available sooner after creation or a filter change. For DDGs with 5,000 members or fewer, membership is now populated as part of the creation or modification operation — no more waiting up to 2 hours.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Choose Anthropic models when editing with Copilot in Word
items.desc: You can choose to select Anthropic models, in addition to OpenAI models, when editing a Word document using Copilot.

items.title: Microsoft Entra: Account Discovery for Application Access Governance.
items.desc:
Account discovery provides visibility into who has access to connected applications by discovering local and orphaned accounts and identifying accounts that can be matched to Microsoft Entra ID users.
Account discovery will help administrators identify access that exists outside of Microsoft Entra ID Governance and bring that access under governance—simplifying application onboarding while improving visibility and control over application access.
items.when: GA: June CY2026 · Preview: April CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Entra: Cross-tenant security group synchronization
items.desc: We’re introducing cross-tenant group synchronization, a new capability that enables organizations to synchronize security groups across Microsoft Entra tenants. This feature simplifies collaboration scenarios by allowing shared access to resources across tenants while maintaining centralized group management. It also streamlines administration of multiple tenants by centralizing group membership control, reducing duplication and manual overhead.
items.when: GA: April CY2026 · Preview: January CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Report a Suspicious Call in Microsoft Teams
items.desc: Microsoft Teams now includes a capability that lets users flag calls they believe are unusual or suspicious. When a call is reported, the signal helps Microsoft strengthen security measures and reduce future unwanted or malicious call activity. This feature empowers users to actively contribute to real-time threat detection, enhancing organizational safety.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Enable watermarks for AI-generated content for M365 Copilot
items.desc: Add watermarks for AI-generated video, audio, and image gen content.

items.title: Microsoft Agent 365: Registry sync
items.desc: Connect to external AI platforms to discover agents created outside Microsoft and automatically sync them into the Agent 365 registry for more complete agent visibility and governance.
items.when: GA: July CY2026 · Preview: May CY2026

items.title: Exchange: High Volume Email for Microsoft 365
items.desc: High Volume Email is a new service for line of business applications and other high-volume SMTP scenarios that enables you to send internal messages beyond the current limits of Exchange Online.
items.when: GA: March CY2026 · Preview: April CY2024

items.title: Microsoft 365: Information Barriers (IB) upgrading from IB v1 to IB v2 with new capabilities
items.desc: Information Barriers (IB) V2 brings new capabilities including larger segment scale support, multi-segment support, and flexible people discoverability etc. Existing IB v1 tenants require an upgrade to IB v2 to take advantage of these new capabilities. This roadmap item is intended only for all IB v1 customers. All other customers will get IB v2 capabilities when they enable IB in their tenants. IB v2 upgrade will be opt-in.
items.when: GA: January CY2027 · Preview: October CY2025
